The do-file behind the published paper. It starts from the "Data Analytic file" made by Step 8. It was run by hand a section at a time, so it has a stop line partway down (now a comment) and creates `VirologicallySuppressed2` twice; read it as a record, not a script that runs straight through. The R translation is in [steps 6 to 9](06_cohort.qmd).

